title: How a wondrous forest has survived in the heart of Latin America’s largest city
summary_full: For almost four decades, the Guarani have fought to expand their four-acre territory, Brazil’s smallest officially recognized Indigenous area, to encompass 1,315 acres of largely preserved forest they consider ancestral land.
